title: GENAI PROJECT
summary: A research repository (GenAIORD) comparing generative approaches for synthetic tabular data, including CTGAN/TVAE and diffusion-style models (c-tab-ddpm), with quality evaluation scripts. It vendors the CTGAN source tree in-tree and calls its TVAESynthesizer/CTGANSynthesizer to train and sample synthetic data, while also importing sdmetrics's QualityReport to score the generated tables.
evidence: c-tab-ddpm/CTGAN/train_sample_tvae.py:5,41 uses vendored TVAESynthesizer; compute_mle.py:22-24 imports sdmetrics QualityReport
needs: Vendored CTGAN copy under c-tab-ddpm/CTGAN/CTGAN also contains rdt transformers used internally; not independently verified as separately invoked outside CTGAN pipeline.
